pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā upanando sakyaputto bhātuno saddhivihārikaṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.11: “nadānāhaṃ āyasmatā upanandena sakyaputtena saddhiṃ janapadacārikaṃ pakkamissāmi, bhagavatā saddhiṃ janapadacārikaṃ pakkamissāmī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.12: atha kho āyasmā upanando sakyaputto taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.14: “nāhaṃ bhante tayā saddhiṃ janapadacārikaṃ pakkamissāmi, bhagavatā saddhiṃ janapadacārikaṃ pakkamissāmī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.15: “yampi tyāhaṃ āvuso cīvaraṃ adāsiṃ mayā saddhiṃ janapadacārikaṃ pakkamissatī”ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.17: atha kho so bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.18: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.19: “kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā upanando sakyaputto bhikkhussa sāmaṃ cīvaraṃ datvā kupito anattamano acchindissatī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.20: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.21: “saccaṃ kira tvaṃ upananda bhikkhussa sāmaṃ cīvaraṃ datvā kupito anattamano acchindī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.24: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa bhikkhussa sāmaṃ cīvaraṃ datvā kupito anattamano acchindissasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.26: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:”
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.27.1: “yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa sāmaṃ cīvaraṃ datvā kupito anattamano acchindeyya vā acchindāpeyya vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti”.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:2.17: sakiṃ āṇatto bahukampi acchindati, nissaggiyaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:2.18: nissajitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:2.21: “idaṃ me bhante cīvaraṃ bhikkhussa sāmaṃ datvā acchinnaṃ nissaggiyaṃ, imāhaṃ saṅghassa nissajjāmī”ti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:2.25.1: upasampanne upasampannasaññī cīvaraṃ datvā kupito anattamano acchindati vā acchindāpeti vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:2.27: upasampanne anupasampannasaññī cīvaraṃ datvā kupito anattamano acchindati vā acchindāpeti vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:2.28: aññaṃ parikkhāraṃ datvā kupito anattamano acchindati vā acchindāpeti vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:2.29: anupasampannassa cīvaraṃ vā aññaṃ vā parikkhāraṃ datvā kupito anattamano acchindati vā acchindāpeti vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
